paragraphs: The Procter & Gamble Company (P&G) is an American multinational consumer goods corporation incorporated and headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. The company was founded in 1837 by William Procter and James Gamble.
Beauty (18% of 2024 revenues), which includes Head & Shoulders, Herbal Essences, Pantene, Rejoice, Olay, Old Spice, Safeguard, Secret, SK-II, and Native;
Grooming (8% of 2024 revenues), which includes Braun, Gillette, and Venus;
Health Care (14% of 2024 revenues), which includes Crest, Oral-B, Metamucil, Neurobion, Pepto-Bismol, and Vicks;
Fabric & Home Care (36% of 2024 revenues), which includes Ariel, Downy, Gain, Tide, Cascade, Dawn, Fairy, Febreze, Mr. Clean, and Swiffer;
Baby, Feminine & Family Care (24% of 2024 revenues), which includes Luvs, Pampers, Always, Tampax, Bounty, Charmin, and Puffs.
description.title: Procter & Gamble

people.name: Shailesh G. Jejurikar
people.title: Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Became President and Chief Executive Officer on January 1, 2026, and Chairman of the Board on August 1, 2026. Previously served as Chief Operating Officer (2021–2025) and Chief Executive Officer - Fabric and Home Care (2019–2021).
people.quote: Shailesh G. Jejurikar | | Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer

people.name: Andre Schulten
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Serves as Chief Financial Officer and was first elected to an officer position in 2021. Has been employed by the Company for more than five years.

people.name: Hesham Tohamy Abd El Hak
people.title: Chief Executive Officer - Baby and Feminine Care
people.bio: Previously served as President - Baby Care from January 1 to June 1, 2026, and President - Feminine Care from 2022 to 2025. Earlier served as Senior Vice President, Feminine Care, North America Brand Franchise Leader from 2018 to 2022.
people.quote: Hesham Tohamy Abd El Hak | | Chief Executive Officer - Baby and Feminine Care

people.name: Juliana Azevedo
people.title: Chief Executive Officer - Grooming
people.bio: Previously served as President - Home Care and P&G Professional, Executive Sponsor, Gender Equality (2024–2026). Earlier served as President - Latin America (2022–2024) and Senior Vice President, Brazil (2018–2022).
people.quote: | Juliana Azevedo | | Chief Executive Officer - Grooming | | 50 | | 2026 (3)

people.name: Freddy Bharucha
people.title: Chief Executive Officer - Beauty
people.bio: Previously served as President - Personal Care and North America Beauty Ecosystem (2023–2025). From 2018 to 2023, served as Senior Vice President - Personal Care, North America, Brand Franchise Leader, Old Spice and Global Commercial Leader, Antiperspirants and Deodorants.
people.quote: | Freddy Bharucha | | Chief Executive Officer - Beauty | | 54 | | 2025 (4)

people.name: Paul Gama
people.title: Chief Executive Officer - Health Care
people.bio: Previously served as President - Personal Health Care from 2020 to 2026. Was first elected to an officer position in 2026.
people.quote: Mr. Gama previously served as President - Personal Health Care (2020 - 2026).

people.name: Sundar G. Raman
people.title: Chief Executive Officer - Fabric and Home Care and Executive Sponsor for Corporate Sustainability
people.bio: Leads Fabric and Home Care and serves as Executive Sponsor for Corporate Sustainability. Was first elected to an officer position in 2021 and has been employed by the Company for more than five years.
people.quote: Sundar G. Raman | | Chief Executive Officer - Fabric and Home Care and Executive Sponsor for Corporate Sustainability

people.name: Victor Aguilar
people.title: Chief Research, Development and Innovation Officer
people.bio: Serves as Chief Research, Development and Innovation Officer and was first elected to an officer position in 2020. Has been employed by the Company for more than five years.
people.quote: Victor Aguilar | | Chief Research, Development and Innovation Officer

people.name: Marc S. Pritchard
people.title: Chief Brand Officer
people.bio: Serves as Chief Brand Officer and was first elected to an officer position in 2008. Has been employed by the Company for more than five years.

people.name: Balaji Purushothaman
people.title: Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President - Human Resources, Global Total Rewards, Employee and Labor Relations and Corporate Services from 2020 to 2022. Was first elected to an officer position in 2023.

people.name: Susan Street Whaley
people.title: Chief Legal Officer and Secretary

people.name: Gary A. Coombe
people.title: CEO - Grooming
people.bio: Coombe serves as CEO - Grooming. The text describes his expatriate assignment in Switzerland.

people.name: B. Marc Allen
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer of Electra.aero since August 2024. Previously held senior leadership positions at Boeing, including President, Boeing International and Chief Strategy Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Allen is the Chief Executive Officer of Electra.aero (aircraft designer and manufacturer), a position he has held since August 2024.

people.name: Craig Arnold
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Former Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Eaton Corporation, serving from 2016 to 2025. Previously held leadership roles at Eaton and General Electric.
people.quote: Mr. Arnold is the former Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Eaton Corporation

people.name: Brett Biggs
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Former Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Walmart, serving from 2016 until June 2022, then Executive Advisor until retirement in January 2023. Previously served as CFO of Walmart International and Walmart U.S.
people.quote: Mr. Biggs is the former Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Walmart, Inc.

people.name: Sheila Bonini
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Senior Vice President of Private Sector Engagement for World Wildlife Fund since 2016. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer of The Sustainability Consortium and spent more than fifteen years with McKinsey & Company.
people.quote: Ms. Bonini is Senior Vice President of Private Sector Engagement for World Wildlife Fund

people.name: Amy L. Chang
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Former Executive Vice President of Cisco Systems and founder and former Chief Executive Officer of Accompany. Previously held positions at Google, eBay, and McKinsey & Company.
people.quote: Ms. Chang is a former Executive Vice President of Cisco Systems, Inc.

people.name: Shailesh G. Jejurikar
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Became President and CEO in January 2026 and Chairman effective August 1, 2026. Joined P&G in 1989 and served as Chief Operating Officer from 2021 to 2025.
people.quote: Mr. Jejurikar is Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company.
